make targets

Every target in the diagram skill's Makefile, grouped. 62 documented. Generated from the Makefile - edit the target's ## line, not this page.

Tests

The four tiers, cheapest first. Where a test LIVES decides when it runs, so these differ by scope rather than by filter.

targetargumentswhat it is
make cov-file
FILE=<test path>the test file to run
MOD=<module path>the module to report coverage for - e.g. `l7r/diagram/settlement/houses.py`
which lines of MOD does ONE test file reach?
make durations
FULL=1also profile `tests/full/` (default: it is ignored, so this is the quick tree only)
MARK=<expr>a pytest `-m` marker expression, e.g. `tooling` (default: `not rolls_map`)
N=<rows>how many of the slowest rows to print (default: 12)
where the suite's time goes - run when a target feels slow
make hooks-test–run every scripts/test-*-hooks.sh, and prove each guard still has a companion
make idle-testsinactive–what an idle session runs unattended (feature 136): the whole gate, never FULL, recorded as `idle-done` arming is disabled - the GM turned it off 2026-09-06; the target still runs by hand
make page-check–the interactive tests + the browser test, then the `page` stamp - what an asset edit owes at push
make quick
ALL=1run EVERY quick test, not just the ones whose code changed (default: change-selected via testmon)
tier 2: lint, types and every test that rolls no map; change-selected, stops at the first failure
make roll-auditMIN_LINESper rolling context of the gate baseline, the engine lines NO other context reaches
make roll-censusFULLthe roll census of the LAST test phase, judged against tests/rolls.py
make soak–the tier ABOVE the gate, run by nothing ordinary (constitution VI v2.23.0): the tests that roll more than the floor needs; REFUSES when empty rather than reporting a vacuous green and larger maps (tests/soak/)
make testinternal–the pytest phase itself (internal - `done` and `test-full` call it, not you)
make test-file
FILE=<paths>the test file(s), a directory, or a node id (`tests/x/test_y.py::test_z`) to run
K=<expr>a pytest `-k` expression - a SUBSET, which owes a whole-file run before the gate
run test files whole, or a targeted subset
make test-full–the gate's whole test phase + all three coverage floors (everything except tests/soak/, which only `make soak` runs)
make tooling–run every `tooling` test (make/ci/pipeline, exhaustive) and record them green so `make quick` skips them until the tooling changes
make verify–THE PAIRED RUN: start the gate and dispatch the settlement-review together (feature 151)

Maps

Generating and checking the pool. `maps` picks its own scope - the reference hamlet alone after a failure, the whole tier after a clean run.

targetargumentswhat it is
make cache-audit–does using the generation cache change any map?
make cohort
N=<seeds>how many seeds to roll (default: 48)
roll N seeds and report every failure
make compound
ARGS=<out.svg>where to write the composed draft
compose a DRAFT Mode A compound plan from a feet-based program - a starting point the GM then refines by hand
make hamlet
ARGS=<cli args>passed to the hamletgen CLI - e.g. `"--name Foo --seed 4 --households 15"`
PROFILE=1also print where the roll spent its time, stage by stage
generate one hamlet from the CLI
make map
GEN=<gen path>which generator to re-run (default: `pool/hamlets/inashiro/inashiro.gen.py`)
PROFILE=1also print where the roll spent its time, stage by stage
regenerate ONE gen and gate it
make maps
SCOPE=reference|alloverride the scope; by default it picks its own - the reference hamlet alone after a failed run, the whole tier after a clean one
regenerate and check the pool, picking its own scope from how the last run went
make placement-stages–re-plate the stage-by-stage walk-through page
make pool-index–rebuild the pool index
make pool-index-if-staleinternal–rebuild the pool index only when a manifest, render or notes file is newer
make render-syncinternal–regenerate MAIN's renders (called by sync-with-main.sh; not for hand use)

Diagnostics

Read-only questions about a finished map or a generator's decisions. None of these decides what ships.

targetargumentswhat it is
make notes-census
M=<glob>which manifests to refresh (default: every manifest in both pool trees)
refresh the derived counts inside each map's notes census block
make pack-audit
ARGS=<in.svg>the Mode A compound SVG to measure
empty space and geometry in a HAND-DRAWN Mode A compound SVG
make page-litCLASS MAP OUT VECTORlight ONE class on a map's page and report which classes' pixels change
make picture-diffA B PAGEtwo renders compared: the differing share, the max delta, the bbox, and whose ink
make why-placed
GEN=<gen path>the map to ask about
AT=x,ywhat was PLACED at this point, and by which stage
REFUSED=x,ywhat was REFUSED here, and which rule refused it
who placed this, and what refused to

Performance

The bookends and the three bands. A run that got slower owes records before the push.

targetargumentswhat it is
make perf
LABEL=<NNN>-start|<NNN>-endwhich bookend this snapshot is (default: `adhoc`, which counts as neither)
take a performance snapshot of the reference hamlet across its seeds
make perf-audit
VERDICT=justified|not-justified|cannot-determinethe band-2 adjudication
NECESSARY=<text>is the slowdown necessary?
COMMENSURATE=<text>is it commensurate with the functionality gained?
NO_WAY_AROUND=<text>was there no good way around it?
AS=perf-auditwho is recording - only the subagent may pass this
band 2 - the subagent adjudicates
make perf-confirminternal
VERDICT=consistent|inconsistentwhether the written cause matches the recorded per-stage delta
AS=perf-auditwho is recording - only the subagent may pass this, and nothing else distinguishes the shells
band 1, second half - the perf-audit SUBAGENT runs this
make perf-explain
WHY=<text>the session's written cause for a band-1 increase
ENV=local|codebuildwhich environment the increase was measured in (default: local)
band 1, first half: the session's written cause
make perf-gate–require the feature's -start bookend, take -end, and FAIL on a regression
make perf-profile
SEED=<n>which seed to profile - e.g. `25`
STAGE=<name>which single stage to cProfile - e.g. `web`
tier 2 evidence: cProfile ONE stage of ONE seed
make perf-report
AGAINST=<NNN>-startcompare the newest snapshot against this bookend
ENV=local|codebuildwhich environment's band-1 line to judge against (default: local)
the trend, and which BAND the newest bookend pair reaches
make perf-review–does every environment's newest bookend pair carry the records its band owes? (the push runs this)
make perf-signoff
WHY=<text>the GM's own reason, given at a terminal - band 3
band 3 - the GM, at a terminal

Remote (AWS CodeBuild)

Everything except `ci-status` costs money. Remote is currently OFF; `make switches` says so.

targetargumentswhat it is
make ci-check
FULL=1full scope instead of reference; PROMPTS, and cancels by default
TARGET=<make target>which target the build runs - e.g. `cohort` (default: the soak suite)
NO_GO=1prove the self-abort path: start the build and never send the go signal
run the SOAK suite on CodeBuild (PAID)
make ci-image–rebuild the CodeBuild image from Dockerfile.ci and push it to ECR (PAID, ~$$1; prompts)
make ci-measure
FULL=1measure the full-scope pair as well as reference
COMPUTE=<codebuild type>which instance size to measure on - e.g. `BUILD_GENERAL1_LARGE`
MEASURE what the remote gate costs (PAID, prompts)
make ci-merge
FULL=1full scope; PROMPTS, and cancels by default
the push's gated route (PAID) - runs the SOAK suite; no longer a merge queue. Called by sync-with-main.sh
make ci-off
REASON=<text>why remote is being switched off - recorded with who and when
REMOTE OFF - nothing dispatches to CodeBuild; the gated push lands on a green local make done
make ci-on
REASON=<text>why remote is being switched back on - recorded with who and when
REMOTE ON - the default; the gated route may dispatch again
make ci-status
ROUTE=1print just DIRECT|GATED instead of the whole condition table
free: delta, route, verification state, verified lookup, remote spend

Static checks

What the gate runs before it spends anything on a map roll.

targetargumentswhat it is
make format–ruff format over the tree
make guardinternal–refuse to run in main's tree - main is the integration point, never a workspace
make static–the static checks: ruff, duplicate-defs, file-scale, stale-dirs (was `lint`)
make typecheck–pyrefly over the engine, one-shot, no daemon (feature 142)

Project state

Switches, audits and the records that make the tooling's own behavior reviewable.

targetargumentswhat it is
make audit–how the gate has actually been used - every run, every bypass, and remote spend
make bypass-audit–every escape token taken, with the reason its user gave (the FULL prompt reads this)
make claim
SLUG=<slug>lower-case kebab; the directory becomes specs/NNN-<slug>/ in THIS clone
PEEK
RENUMBER
claim the next spec-kit feature number under the host-wide lock
make commit-permitted–commit the most recent bypass-log entry, which is how a paid FULL run is authorized
make docs–regenerate docs/make-targets.html from this Makefile's own `##` lines
make engine-key
REF=<commit>which commit to key (default: HEAD)
the content hash the gate and the push key on
make guard-logEVENT FULL GUARD SINCEthe guard firings, listed - GUARD=<name> SINCE=YYYY-MM-DD EVENT=blocked|rewrote|escaped|reminded FULL=1
make help–list every target with its one-line purpose
make switches–the iteration switch: remote on|off, with reason, who and when (feature 132)
make tick
F=<feature>the feature number or slug - e.g. `188`
T=<task>the task id - e.g. `T03`
NOTE=<text>what was VERIFIED, which is what the tick is asserting
BOXES=1also tick the three physical-research boxes (only legitimate on a `research: physical` task)
tick a task: F=188 T=T03 NOTE="what was verified" [BOXES=1 ticks the research boxes]
